title: Delphi workspace config.toml
description: Validate config.toml parsed to JSON. Shape and enumerations only: `delphi doctor` is authoritative and also checks credentials, ratification and cross-references. Sections the code reads but that this schema leaves open (session, relay, away, optimistic, learning, hooks) are declared as plain objects. [[endpoints]], [access], [auth.*], [connectors.*], [harness.*] and [exec] are ratified: a change is a Red-tier proposal. API keys never appear here. The annotated template is crates/delphi/config.example.toml.

projects.description: Project repos the workspace operates on; `~/` is expanded.

untrusted_paths.description: Globs whose tracked files read as external_untrusted.

isolated.description: True: nothing is ever promoted out of this workspace.

hide_bibliographies.description: When searching the knowledge base in the console, resolve to summary markdown pages instead of bibliography sidecars (specs/075). Default true.

models.description: `[models.<family>]` maps tier to model ID; `[models.catalog."<id>"]` holds per-model limits and prices.

interactive.description: Roles the operator can directly @ on session start.

forbidden.description: Quarantined roles; orchestrator dispatch and direct interaction are blocked.

fleet.description: Fleet accessibility mode for the orchestrator (default: all).

adopt_threshold.description: The confidence at or above which route marks its best candidate adopt = true (specs/098 section 8). Provisional default 0.55; delphi route --adopt-eval measures a labeled set.

registry.description: How the orchestrator learns of bundle agents (specs/041). flat: one line per agent, up to 20. auto: past 20, a domain index and the search_agent_registry tool.

assignment.description: How a dispatch picks its model (specs/056). static: the role's tier. discovered: capability class, measured results and quota.

evidence_enough.description: Measured results per (role, kind, model) after which a model is scored by them alone.

emergency_endpoint.description: A local endpoint (cost_model = local) whose model saves state when every ratified seat is out of quota (specs/056 section 3.5). Set together with emergency_model; off when unset.

emergency_model.description: The model on emergency_endpoint that writes the unverified emergency hand-off record.

reserve.description: Role to the share of the mission budget no other role may spend.

council.description: Councils, Panels and the progress a status call reports (spec 098 section 19).

stall_secs.description: A status call flags a Council stalled when every seat still working has been idle this many seconds (default 120). 0 turns the flag off.

hosts.description: Settings for the tools you code with (specs/098).

route_adopt.description: Whether route's adopt is a recommendation (true) or only advice (false, the default). It changes what the answer says, not what Delphi does.

source_ladder.description: Whether the packs served for the scout, investigator and red team end with the source ladder, and `delphi mcp --print-claude-md` includes the research reflex (specs/098 section 7). false by default. Advice for the host; it grants nothing.

seats.description: Foreign seats and model families (spec 091 SR-3, SR-4).

require_families.description: Refuse a Panel that cannot show this many distinct known model families, before anything is spent. Unset (the default) never refuses; the result is labelled homogeneous.

max_foreign_seats.description: Foreign seats one Council may run (default 1). 0 turns them off.

red_team_kind.description: Accept kind: red_team on council_open: a red-team review whose result is a findings list with each seat's family from its receipt (spec 098 section 6.2). Default false.

max_foreign_tokens.description: Tokens the foreign seats of one Council may use (default 100000).

nudge_edits.description: Writes to one file before the nudge; twice this ends the span.

tool_result_limit_kb.description: A tool result over this many KB is stored in the payload store and the history keeps a handle and a preview. 0 is off.

clear_after_kb.description: Old tool results are replaced by a handle in batches of about this many KB. 0 is off.

trim_arguments_kb.description: Old tool calls whose arguments reach this many KB keep a handle in place of their large text fields. 0 is off.

keep_recent_turns.description: Assistant turns, counted from the end, that clearing and trimming leave whole.

hard.description: Shell lines that are always Hard: a Red card.

search.description: Web search engines for the archives pane's research mode (specs/028 section 10), tried in order, one at a time. Unset means the keyless parallel engine (specs/028 section 12); an empty list means research cannot run.

research.description: How a research answer describes its coverage (specs/098 section 7.5).

young_domain_days.description: A registrable domain younger than this counts zero toward corroboration, when its age is known (specs/098 section 7.6). Default 180.

burst_hours.description: Citations first seen within this many hours of each other count once, when their first-seen times are known. Default 24.

similar_above.description: Pages more similar than this are one origin. Never looser than the validator's own 0.5 (specs/040 section 6.2). Default 0.8.

unfamiliar_counts.description: Whether a domain no list names counts as an origin. A domain a list calls weak, and every excluded one, count zero either way. Default true.

thin_below.description: Fewer kept, cited claims than this from the knowledge base and the trusted sources together make a research answer say coverage: thin, and name the host rungs (close sources, the wider web) that can take over. Default 3.

archive_fallback.description: Archived copies (specs/101 section 5). On: when a re-check finds a PUBLIC source the daemon fetched itself gone, and no readable text is held, the daemon asks one web archive whether it holds a copy and keeps it as a labelled version of the source. Read-only (nothing is ever saved to the archive); a private source or an address that is not public sends nothing; a copy adds no origin and no trusted source. The explicit command `delphi sources archive` works either way. Default false.

archive_endpoint.description: The one archive endpoint asked about a public URL (specs/101 section 7): the Internet Archive's Availability API by default. Must be https. Default https://archive.org/wayback/available.

ladder.description: The wider fetch (specs/098 section 7.5 item 7a). Off: the daemon's fetch reaches trusted-list hosts only. On: it also reaches an https URL that a search of the run returned (for a host's claim, one that an earlier search of the same host session returned), inside the two caps below. A URL nobody searched for, and any link found on a page, are never fetched. Default false.

fetch_per_host.description: With the wider fetch on: distinct off-list pages read from one host in one run. A hypothesis to calibrate from the status. Default 2.

fetch_per_run.description: With the wider fetch on: distinct off-list pages read in one run. A hypothesis to calibrate from the status. Default 10.

search_log.description: Write a search log beside each host research result (specs/101 section 3): every search with the query that was sent, when, and how many results came back and were kept, and a flow that adds up. A search withheld for a private claim carries no query text. Private when any claim it served is. Default false.

tiers.description: The confidence ladder (specs/100 section 3.2): when a claim reads corroborated, substantiated or vetted. Derived by code from tags; each rung reads not validated (vetted reads vetted) and is weaker than validated; none grants anything. Numbers are defaults to calibrate.

substantiated_trusted.description: Trusted sources, among those origins, for substantiated. Default 1.

vetted_origins.description: Independent origins for vetted (never fewer than corroborated_origins). Default 5.

vetted_trusted.description: Trusted sources for vetted (never fewer than substantiated_trusted); vetted also needs the validator's would_ratify. Default 2.

corroborated_enabled.description: Whether the corroborated rung is shown. Off: the claim reads noted. Default true.

substantiated_enabled.description: Whether the substantiated rung is shown. Off: it falls back one rung. Default true.

vetted_enabled.description: Whether the vetted rung is shown. Off: it falls back one rung. Default true.

fast_lane_enabled.description: Whether the validator is offered a higher rung's claims first (queue order only; a claim's status never changes). Default true.

acquire.description: Library acquisition (specs/055 section 8): a daily job proposes public-domain and research sources in ONE digest batch. Off until enabled; it reaches out to the archives listed in context/sources/archives.toml.

byte_budget_mib.description: Bytes acquisition may hold; reaching it stops acquiring and evicts nothing.

max_item_mib.description: The largest text one acquired source may have.

token_share_percent.description: The scout's share of the install's tokens over the trailing week (specs/040 section 20.2). 0 keeps the job model-free.

interests.description: Topics you want, beside the workspace's project names.

validator.description: The fact validator (specs/040 section 15.1). The effective mode is the lower of this value and the daemon's latch.

mode.description: off: no fetch of any kind. advisory: the full fact path as a dry run that writes nothing validated. ratify: real writes, only after PROMOTE.

weak_sources.description: A claim supported only by Weak sources: label keeps it as unverified (weak), never as evidence; off refuses it (specs/040 section 27).

sources.description: The operator's additions to the default source list (specs/040 appendix A). Registrable domains.

private_to_models.description: Whether a private entry may be placed in the prompt of a model of the host's own family (specs/098 section 7.2). A private entry is never placed in a foreign-family seat's prompt, whatever this says. `delphi doctor` warns when it is `allow` and private entries exist.

pages.description: Generated search pages (specs/057 sections 5 and 6). A page is always labelled generated and not authoritative.

enabled.description: false: no page is written; searches still list the library's results.

external.description: ask: external search only when the operator asks (--external, or the console's key). off: never. on: every page also searches the web, unless --internal. Private sources never leave the install.

max_tokens.description: The longest page the writer may write, in tokens.

external_ttl.description: How long a page that used external search stays fresh: a number of days, or a duration such as 12h or 7d.

per_day.description: Pages the daemon builds in one day (a cache hit is free). Their validator tokens also count against the validator's share (specs/040 section 20).

min_ttl_days.description: The shortest cache lifetime, in days, the daemon accepts for a page the writer proposed one for (specs/097).

max_ttl_days.description: The longest cache lifetime, in days, the daemon accepts for a page the writer proposed one for (specs/097).

order.description: Family to endpoint IDs, in preference order.

harness.description: `[harness.claude]`, `[harness.agy]`, `[harness.codex]` and `[harness.copilot]` narrow the subscription-CLI defaults; scalar keys on `[harness]` itself (for example connector_settle_secs, subscription_budget_tokens) apply to all.

grades.description: Promote and nerf (specs/056 §4): a role's grade from -2 to 2, or a table of grades per task kind with `default` for the role itself. Ratified: an edit is a pending proposal until /ratify.

learning.description: The learning loop (specs/031 section 3.6). Each number is clamped to the core's floor and ceiling at boot. No key loads unratified content; an unknown key is a boot notice.

capture.description: Stage notes from denials, corrections, retries and escalations. Default true. Turning it off is allowed.

max_notes.description: Staged notes kept per mission; the oldest is dropped. Default 200.

triggers.description: Which capture triggers are on. Default all.

retro_min_tasks.description: Finished tasks before `delphi needs` says the coaching pass has material. Default 10.

exposure_randomization.description: Withhold a newly ratified rule from about half of its first 20 tasks to measure it; security and always rules and holdout tasks never. Default false.

mcp.description: Delphi for host agents (specs/062 section 3.4): `delphi mcp`, an MCP server on stdio for the other tools you code with. Same machine and same user only.

enabled.description: false: every tool call is answered `disabled_by_operator`. Read at each call, so it takes effect at once. A config.toml that cannot be read as written also turns it off.

allow_remote.description: Reserved for a later spec. true is refused in this version.

badge_style.description: Which form of a Delphi agent's identity the `display` and `signature` fields carry (specs/066 section 7, specs/087 section 5). Plain is the default; the ansi and markdown forms are always sent beside it.

badge_mode.description: The terminal background the ANSI form of an identity is coloured for (specs/087 section 5.1). Delphi cannot see the host's terminal, so the operator says it once. The plain and markdown forms carry no colour and ignore it.

badge_ascii.description: Whether the badge in an identity is plain ASCII (for example [0-0] for the badge with the bullet-dash-bullet face), for a host whose terminal or font cannot draw the badge characters (specs/087 section 6.2). DELPHI_ASCII_BADGES=1 in the environment of the process that builds the identity has the same effect.

max_packs_per_task.description: How many different generated packs (spawn_agent_pack) one named task may have (specs/098 section 9). A cap on one-off agent definitions, not on calls: asking again for a pack already made costs nothing. 0 allows none.

max_packs_per_session.description: How many different generated packs one server session may have in all, so a host that cycles task names cannot spawn packs without end (specs/098 section 9). 0 allows none.

host.description: Subagent files for the other tools (specs/086 section 6.3).

models.description: Host, then council role, to the model name that host's generated subagent file asks for. Only hosts that take free names; no entry means the file sets no model.

auto.description: A root span starts with at most three passages (1 500 characters) from the knowledge base, labelled and tainted. false: agents search only when they call kb_search.

hooks.description: `[[hooks.observe]]` and `[[hooks.deny]]` (specs/018): commands that can only watch or refuse.

credential.description: Where the key comes from, as for an endpoint.

cx.description: Google only: the Programmable Search engine id.

credential.description: A credential reference (for example `aws:work-sso`), or `none` for a loopback base_url. Never a secret.

client_secret.description: A reference such as `keychain:google-client-secret`, never the secret.

harnessProfile.description: Unknown keys are refused by the program.
